get.description: Whether someone who forgot their password can ask Horatio for a link.

post.description:
Email a reset link to an account's own address, if an account uses it. The
answer is the same either way, so it never says who has an account; so is
being turned away for asking too often.

Set a new password from a reset link. Ends every other session the person had,
and signs them in here.

get.description: Whose password a reset link sets, so the page can say.

The backup's file. It holds everything, password hashes included, so each
download is logged.

schema.title: Response My Characters Api Characters Get

post.description: Players build characters on their own, outside any troupe.

delete.description:
Delete a character for good. It must be in no troupe: leaving each one first
is what tells those troupes' storytellers.

patch.description:
Rename the character: its player, at most once every three months while it is
in a troupe, or the custodian at any time (see horatio/renames.py).

get.description:
One character's badge, with its titles in `troupe_id` (by default its home
troupe, else the first troupe it joined).

put.description:
Build by a troupe's rules (or, with none, the plain rule set) until a home
troupe accepts the character; then that troupe's rules apply.

post.description:
Make a list of sheet changes in one transaction, each priced as if the
earlier ones had been made, and the sheet they end with checked against the
one they started from. If any is refused, none is made, and each line says
what it costs or why it is refused. A dry run says the same, saving nothing.

put.description: Replace every creation pick in one category at once: one step of the wizard.

delete.description: Take back discipline dots still waiting on the home troupe, and get the XP back.

get.description: Delivered downtime results for the player's character, newest first.

schema.title: Response My Results Api Characters  Character Id  Downtime Results Get

post.description: The differences the player must settle to make `troupe_id` the home troupe.

schema.title: Response Preview Home Troupe Api Characters  Character Id  Home Troupe Preview Post

post.description: Where the character's XP stands against `troupe_id`'s floor and ceiling.

get.description:
Everything that happened to the character, newest first. Its player sees it
all; a troupe's staff see the sheet's own history and what happened in their
troupe, not in the character's other troupes.

schema.title: Response Character Log Api Characters  Character Id  Log Get

put.description: Set one of an NPC's traits straight to a rating, and get the new tally.

get.description: What the NPC's sheet would be worth in experience under its troupe's rules.

delete.description: Take the picture away. Whoever uploaded it is told, unless it was them.

post.description:
A new picture, replacing any the character has. Without a crop, the
portrait is the biggest square in the middle.

put.description: Move the portrait's crop, cutting it again from the picture as kept.

get.description:
One of the picture's files. A picture's files never change (a new one has a
new id), so browsers may keep them; privately, as only some people see them.
The character's trackers and limited uses at the game now, and its log.

post.description: A counter of the player's own, such as "Fetish charges: 3".

delete.description: Take a counter off the Play View; old logs still name it.

get.description: Games already over, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Games Api Characters  Character Id  Play Games Get

get.description: One game's log, newest first, such as a past game's for the next downtime.

post.description:
Reset for the next game: the game ends, kept with its log, and every tracker
goes back where the sheet starts it.
Record taps, perhaps made offline a while ago, in the order they happened.

put.description:
Add or change what an influence spend was for, from the game's log. Anyone
who can see the sheet can until the game ends; after that, only the staff who
keep the troupe's influence log.
Name the primary path of a discipline, for a clan with no in-clan path.

get.description:
The sheet as it stands, headed for `troupe_id` (by default the home troupe, else
the first troupe joined), whose titles it shows.

post.description: What a change would cost, without making it.
Characters are never deleted, only retired.

schema.title: Response Character Kinds Api Characters  Character Id  Specializations Get

post.description: Swap a focus (or another swappable choice) for another, for its change cost.

put.description: Fill in a trait's missing detail, such as a Crafts bought without a field.

schema.title: Response Memberships Api Characters  Character Id  Troupes Get

post.description: Add the character to a troupe. Its staff can then see the sheet.

delete.description: Leave a troupe. Leaving the home troupe leaves the character without one.

get.description:
Traits in `category` the character cannot take, and why: with the sheet as it
is; as if the category's creation picks were `picks` (a wizard step not yet
saved); or as if the category held nothing (what is barred whatever is chosen).

schema.title: Response Unavailable Api Characters  Character Id  Unavailable Get

put.description:
What others can see or sense about the character that the rules data does
not cover, for its badge. Written by staff, not the player.

schema.title: Response Xp History Api Characters  Character Id  Xp Get

post.description: Storytellers and assistant storytellers of the character's home troupe award XP.

A player adds XP to their own character while it has no home troupe, such
as for one played elsewhere. The troupe it asks to join accepts or removes it.

Correct a mistaken award with a new entry; the award itself is left as written.
Whoever may award the character XP may correct it, and a player their own
self-entered XP while the character has no home troupe.
A clan's logo, replacing any it has.

get.description: A logo's file, for anyone signed in. Like pictures' files, they never change.
Each submission against each channel: how its delivery went.

schema.title: Response My Responses Api Cycles  Cycle Id  Responses Mine Get

put.description:
Change the signed-in person's handle: at most once in 30 days, and to one no
one has or has held in the last 90.

get.description:
People to pick from, a page at a time: everyone, or with `q` those whose
handle starts with it, then those whose name has it in it. Only for those who
pick people: the custodian, and for a troupe, those who manage its staff, who
see its players first and who is on its staff already.

post.description: Merge repeats into this entry: their times add to its own.

get.description:
For the custodian: the reset links live now, and who has made, asked for and
used them.
Every account whose name, handle or email has `q` in it, for the custodian.

to anyone but themself and the custodian.

patch.description: Change some settings; the rest stay as they are.

get.description: Whether notifications can come by email here (horatio.notification_emails).

delete.description: Take an answer back off the log.

post.description: Log a player's influence answer, with its purpose trimmed by staff.

get.description:
The rule set's categories and traits, with any house-rule text from `troupe_id`.
A troupe that takes only some sects does not see traits for the others (the
Sabbat's Rituals), nor a category left empty without them.

For the custodian: what is waiting, longest waiting first, then the latest
decided.

sends the storyteller back to `/api/discord/callback`.
A game the troupe will run, for its profile's schedule.

The troupe's entries, newest first, filtered. `since` counts from that moment
